title: melampyrum subalpinum
intro: Melampyrum subalpinum, commonly known as alpine monkey flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. This hemiparasitic plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Melampyrum subalpinum include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and act as an expectorant to aid in the removal of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
